channel.description: Latest articles from New York Daily News (nydailynews.com)

item.title: The Jets interview five candidates for offensive coordinator position
item.description: Aaron Glenn reached out to Frank Reich about joining the Jets staff in some capacity, per source.

item.title: Islanders roll past Rangers 5-2 in Ondrej Palat’s first game
item.description: The Rangers host the Islanders on Thursday for the second half of a home-and-home.

item.title: Candace Owens leaks ‘off-putting’ audio of Erika Kirk in wake of husband’s killing
item.description: Candace Owens has leaked audio from a conference call in which Erika Kirk expressed an "upbeat" attitude less than two weeks after the assassination of her husband.

item.title: Mikal Bridges erupts for 30 points, takes accountability in Knicks’ win vs. Raptors
item.description: The Knicks used a 25-4 third-quarter run to turn a 12-point deficit into a 119-92 victory.

item.title: Lawsuit targets NYPD car stops as racially discriminatory, likened to ‘stop and frisk on wheels’
item.description: Blacks and Hispanics made up 90% of arrests resulting from NYPD car stops, the suit says, despite accounting for only 45% of the driving population.

item.title: NYPD investigating car driving into Chabad’s Brooklyn headquarters as hate crime
item.description: Video posted online shows a Honda sedan repeatedly slamming into an entrance to the Chabad headquarters, with the driver backing up and then accelerating into a pair of double doors multiple times.

item.title: Readers sound off on protest hypocrisy, deadly feds and a distasteful comic
item.description: Valhalla, N.Y.: Iranian citizens protesting and fighting against the oppressive, stifling rule of an ultra-conservative theocracy are to be lauded by freedom-loving people everywhere. President Trump is correct to encourage and support their actions, violent though they may be.

item.title: Welcome to Rikers, Mr. Deml: Remediation manager’s monumental task with the city jail
item.description: Manhattan Federal Judge Laura Taylor Swain handing control of Rikers Island to her appointee Nicholas Deml must be respected by Mayor Mamdani and his Department of Correction. Deml, backed up by the judge, needs the executive power to address the many overlapping emergencies on Rikers and she instructed him to get to work immediately. Swain gave Deml and the city just three weeks to come up with a joint logistical plan for Deml to begin carrying out his mission. Good; we have no time to waste.

item.title: Today in History: January 29, Bush warns of ‘axis of evil’
item.description: President George W. Bush said terrorists were still threatening America — and warned of “an axis of evil” consisting of North Korea, Iran and Iraq.

item.title: NYPD’s Tisch must heed Mamdani’s lead
item.description: No post-election decision by Mayor Mamdani garnered more attention than keeping Jessica Tisch as police commissioner. She’s served with a level of honesty and professionalism her recent predecessors lacked, but she carries over from an administration whose response to the complex needs of our city was too often cops, cops, and more cops.
